The back camera now shows a picture that can be swapped from the terminal, so apps that scan QR codes can be tested without a phone. `sk` also sets sensors, switches the home screen app and makes a port on the device reachable from the network, and `sk seed` brings more kinds of test files. The back camera's default changes from the moving test scene to a QR code; `EMULATOR_CAMERA_BACK=emulated` brings the scene back.

## ✨ Added

- **A QR code in front of the back camera.** `EMULATOR_CAMERA_BACK=picture`, the new default, shows a QR code that `sk camera` swaps for another one or for a picture of your own. The emulator reads the picture again each time an app opens the camera, so no restart is needed. Scanning apps read QR codes this way; linear barcodes such as EAN-13 are not recognised through the emulated camera, so those are on the device as pictures for apps that import one.
- **More test files from `sk seed`:** a MusicXML score, a ChordPro song, a GPX track, a calendar event with a reminder, and QR codes for a URL, text, a Wi-Fi network, a one-time password and a contact, next to an EAN-13 and a Code 128 barcode. All of them point nowhere real.
- **New `sk` commands:**
  - `sk camera <code|file>` picks what the back camera sees.
  - `sk sensor` lists the sensors, `sk sensor pressure 950` sets one.
  - `sk home pixel|lawnchair` switches the home screen app. Home screen widgets show on pixel.
  - `sk expose <port>` makes a port that an app on the device listens on reachable at the container's address, so a second device can join it. `sk expose off <port>` closes it again.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **`sk netlog stop` with no traffic.** When an app sent nothing, the capture file was empty and the command failed. It now says that nothing was recorded.
